# v1.2.0 – Fluid simulations

Water on the flip-dot board: eight small physics simulations, each telling a short story and ending on an empty board.

![Dam break](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Subnet-Zero/fluepdot-ha/v1.2.0/docs/fluid.gif)

### New
- **`fluepdot.fluid`** action with `simulation`, `duration`, `delay`, optional `text` and `seed`.
- **`select.flipdot_fluid_simulation`** – pick a simulation from the dropdown and it plays right away.
- **`button.flipdot_play_fluid_simulation`** – play the selected one again.
- Simulations: `pour`, `wave`, `rain`, `dam_break`, `slosh`, `drain`, `fountain`, `ripple` and `surprise`.
  Waves and bulk water use the 1D shallow-water equations, so waves steepen into breakers on their own;
  streams, rain, splashes and spray are ballistic drops.
- `text` stays readable (inverted) inside the water and remains at the end; with `drain` the letters are solid and catch water.
- `scripts/preview_fluid.py` plays the simulations as ASCII in the terminal and writes animated GIFs – no Home Assistant needed.

### Fixed
- When a running animation was replaced by a new one, the old caller could restart the page rotation on top of the new animation.

### Tip
Flip dots are mechanical: turning on `switch.flipdot_differential_rendering` makes the animations noticeably smoother.
